name: Moby
author: GodsWildOnes
description: A quick view of Moby's fill monitoring, queued assets and withdrawals.

schema.label: Read local status while open (seconds)
schema.description: Reads Moby's cache, not Kraken. Closed panels read every 30 seconds or slower.

schema.label: Moby executable
schema.description: moby on PATH, or an absolute executable path. No shell commands or flags.

schema.label: Custom Moby data root (optional)
schema.description: Leave blank for Moby's normal data location. Must match the running worker.
